feedback: This candidate is well-structured and consistent with the previous iteration's rationale. The integral gain ki has been reduced from 0.5 to 0.2, which is expected to reduce overshoot and oscillations based on iteration 0 evidence. The line_loss strategy has been changed from 'last_direction' to 'search_left' to test if this improves recovery from line loss events, as recommended if line loss is frequent. Sensor weights, PID gains kp and kd, and sensor size remain unchanged to isolate the effects of these changes. Depending on the next race results, if oscillations or line loss events remain high, consider further tuning ki (possibly lower or slightly higher) or adjusting sensor weights to improve signal quality. If line loss events decrease but progress or completion is low, consider increasing base_speed slightly or adjusting line_loss strategy again. If steering oscillation remains high, consider reducing kd or adjusting sensor weights to smooth control signals.
